items.q: What is Nolan actually betting $250M on?
items.a: [[analog-imax-bet]]. **41** 70mm IMAX screens, **none in Asia**. **610 km** of stock. No VFX — real sea. The stream was supposed to replace the room. He spent the other way.

items.q: Why open on 千与千寻?
items.a: Circe already wrote the pig dinner. **3,000 years** back. Damon, handed the book: *I haven't read that*. Fine. The story was never a king.

items.q: How should you hold the two Homer books?
items.a: *Iliad* = **封神 / war**. *Odyssey* = **西游 / road**. Helen is the oath. The **strait** is the bill. The horse is **not** in the *Iliad*.

items.q: Why is the cleverest Greek the lead of a homecoming?
items.a: He **salted the field** to dodge the war, then wrote the Helen-oath that bound him. Force is Achilles. Command is Agamemnon. Brains that wanted out is Odysseus.

items.q: What does kleos want that nostos will not trade?
items.a: [[kleos-vs-nostos]]. Kleos = **that which is heard**. Achilles picks a short name. Odysseus is offered **forever** and takes the door. The sequel overrules the first book's god.

items.q: What do the Sirens actually sing?
items.a: Not a love song. **We know what happened under Troy.** He plugs the crew and keeps his own ears. Same hunger as shouting the real name off the boat.

items.q: Did Nolan invent the non-linear cut?
items.a: [[in-medias-res]]. Homer opens **war year 10** / **raft year 10**. Hero absent until book 5. Horace named 拦腰法. Virgil copied the banquet. Nolan inherited it.

items.q: What is the test that is the whole book?
items.a: [[recognition-by-private-detail]]. Move the bed. He snaps: the post is a **living olive**. Only two people know. Kleos is a crowd. This is a household.
